rows.criteria: Winter tyres on all wheels; studless tyres require 3PMSF; winter tread at least 3 mm.
rows.note: The authority includes 1 March; N1 and O2 are outside this M1 row.

rows.criteria: Winter tyres designed for snow and ice with 3PMSF marking; minimum tread 4 mm.
rows.note: The transport ministry publishes the current CSDD explanation for light vehicles.

rows.criteria: Summer tyres prohibited; winter, all-season or studded tyres allowed, with at least 3 mm tread.
rows.note: Police describe the seasonal prohibition on summer tyres.

rows.criteria: Winter tyres on every wheel; 3PMSF or M+S, M&S, M S marking; tread on snow or ice must exceed 4 mm absent wear indicators.
rows.note: December through February for M1 and N1; regional extensions require separate rows.

rows.criteria: Winter tyres on all wheels with 3PMSF and M+S, M&S or M S marking, as described by police.
rows.note: Government police guidance names December through February.

rows.criteria: Winter tyres if weather or road conditions require them; non-studded tyres require 3PMSF and winter tread at least 3 mm.
rows.note: Weather-dependent duty; no unconditional change deadline.

rows.criteria: Winter tyres or equivalent equipment in snow, ice, slush or frost; car tyres must be 3PMSF or studded, with at least 3 mm tread.
rows.note: Police decide whether a road has winter conditions.

rows.criteria: Winter tyres on all wheels in wintry conditions, marked M+S, M.S., M&S or snowflake; chains can substitute on continuous snow or ice.
rows.note: Only when driven in snow, slush or ice.

rows.criteria: All wheels must have tyres satisfying StVZO section 36(4), including the Alpine symbol, in black ice, snow, slush, ice or frost.
rows.note: Full-year range represents possible situational applicability, not a national change date.

rows.criteria: Sufficient grip required year-round; winter tread and studded-tyre periods have separate dates.
rows.note: No nationwide fixed winter-tyre change date for light vehicles; northern regions have different tread and studded-tyre periods.

rows.criteria: No statutory winter-tyre obligation; safe road grip remains the driver's responsibility.
rows.note: Polish police expressly state there is no statutory winter-tyre obligation.

rows.criteria: Winter tyres when continuous snow, ice or frost is on the road or expected during travel; minimum tread 4 mm.
rows.note: Weather-dependent duty; road signs can add local requirements.
